import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD1 = 1000000007L;
    static final long MOD2 = 998244353L;
    static final int maxk = 7;
    static final int base = 1000000;
    static long n;
    static long ord;
    static int ans;
    static int[] sum = new int[maxk];
    static List<Integer>[] v = new ArrayList[maxk];

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < maxk; i++) {
            v[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static void dfs1(long x, int len) {
        ord++;
        int val = (int)(((ord - x) % MOD2 + MOD2) % MOD2);
        v[len].add(val);
        sum[len] = (sum[len] + val) % (int)MOD1;
        if (len == 6) {
            return;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
            dfs1(x * 10 + i, len + 1);
        }
    }

    static void dfs2(long x) {
        if (x > n) {
            return;
        }
        if (x * base + base - 1 <= n && x * base * 10 > n) {
            long now = ord;
            for (int i = 0, mul = 1; i <= 6; i++, mul *= 10) {
                int sz = v[i].size();
                int dif = (int)(((now - x * mul) % MOD2 + MOD2) % MOD2);
                int pos = lowerBound(v[i], (int)(MOD2 - dif));
                ans = (int)((ans + 1L * dif * sz + sum[i]) % MOD1);
                ans = (int)((ans - (MOD1 * (sz - pos) % MOD1) + MOD1) % MOD1);
                ord += sz;
            }
            return;
        }
        ord++;
        ans = (int)((ans + ((ord - x) % MOD2 + MOD2) % MOD2) % MOD1);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
            dfs2(x * 10 + i);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Integer> list, int target) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= target) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
        ord = 0;
        dfs1(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(v[i]);
        }
        ord = 0;
        ans = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 9; i++) {
            dfs2(i);
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
